summary: Every party is a ticket: a condensed time stub, a perforated edge, then the facts. Status lives in the stub, so red appears only on a missing deposit.

world.name: Ticket
world.summary: Warm paper, deep teal and indigo, one violet accent. Condensed Bulgarian-Cyrillic display type for times and names, a quiet grotesk for everything else.
world.signature: The ticket stub: time sits in a stub cut off by a perforated dashed edge with two punched notches. The stub carries the status color, so a missing deposit is the only solid red stub on any screen.
rules: Do put the time in a ticket stub and the facts in the body; the stub carries the status color.
Do keep the stub neutral for a healthy party; only a missing deposit gets a solid red stub, a clash or a gap gets an amber tint.
Don't fill empty hours with placeholder rows; empty time is white space on the grid.
Don't show a money figure the data does not hold; write 'не е зададено'.
Dark is the ticket printed in cream on navy card stock: the paper hue becomes the ink and the ink hue becomes the page; teal, indigo and violet lift to pastel so they still read as marks, not fills.

components.name: Page shell
components.what: The page frame under the top bar: padded, centred, at most 1800px wide, with room left for the phone tab bar. Takes the page header and the screen's columns as children.

components.name: Top bar
components.what: Sticky app bar with the PartyFox brand, the desktop navigation with the current page highlighted, and who is signed in; the navigation hides on phones.

components.name: Phone tab bar
components.what: Fixed bottom navigation with an icon and label per section, shown only under 720px, current tab in the primary color.

components.name: Avatar
components.what: Round initial of a person in the secondary color; the top bar shows the signed-in one.

components.name: Page header
components.what: Screen title with a one-line summary under it and an optional right side for counts, filters or a button.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.what: Small muted path back to the day and the order above a booking.

components.name: Section
components.what: A titled block of a screen: a heading with an optional count badge, then its children (a list, a form). Takes children and knows nothing about them.

components.name: Card
components.what: Surface with a border, an optional header row holding a title and a small action or count, and a padded body. Takes children.

components.name: Fact list
components.what: Two-column list of label and value; a value the data does not hold shows the unset value.

components.name: Button
components.what: Action in default, primary, secondary and ghost looks, small and full-width sizes, as a button or a link, with an optional leading icon.

components.name: Badge
components.what: The status tag: a pill label in neutral, primary, secondary, accent, ok and warning tints; the solid red danger badge is used only for a missing deposit.

components.name: Unset value
components.what: The italic muted text for a figure the data does not hold ('не е зададено'), used wherever money would go.

components.name: Chip
components.what: Small pressable pill with an optional count; pressed it fills with ink. One choice in a filter or a cover picker.

components.name: Filter chips
components.what: Row of chips with counts that filters the list next to it; one chip is pressed at a time.

components.name: Search field
components.what: Pill-shaped search with a magnifier icon that filters the families list as you type, with a focus ring.

components.name: Form field
components.what: A label above one control (text input, text area or segmented control), with an optional hint.

components.name: Text input
components.what: Single-line input with a placeholder, used for the leave dates.

components.name: Text area
components.what: Multi-line input for a message to the parent or a leave reason, resizable down.

components.name: Segmented control
components.what: Two-way switch such as Viber or email and whole day or hours, one option pressed in the primary color.

components.name: Status note
components.what: Inline message block in warning, danger, ok, neutral and info tints, used for clashes, missing addresses, hints and unset money.

components.name: Tooltip
components.what: Full text on hover for a cut-off ticket title and for the deposit-paid tick in the schedule.

components.name: Toast
components.what: Short confirmation after an action such as a reminder sent, a deposit marked or a leave request sent.

components.name: Ticket
components.what: The signature frame: a stub cut off by a perforated edge with two punched notches, then a body with a title, a meta line and children. Looks: neutral, ok, warning (amber tint), danger (solid red, missing deposit only) and hatched for leave; sizes sm, normal and lg; can be a link, a pressed button or selected. Party, order, leave request and family tickets are built on it.

components.name: Ticket stub
components.what: The left part of a ticket: a big condensed figure (a time, a count of days or parties) with a small line under it (until when, the date). Carries the status color.

components.name: Party ticket
components.what: One party as a ticket: start time in the stub, the child, age and package as the title, then animator, guests and address. Small on the schedule grid, normal in lists, large as the hero of a booking and of today's party; status from the deposit and clashes.

components.name: Order ticket
components.what: One site order as a ticket: wanted time and date in the stub, child and package, parent, guests, address, and tags for its state and size. Pressable and selected in the inbox list, large and static at the top of the order detail.

components.name: Leave request ticket
components.what: One leave request as a ticket: days or hours in the stub, who and the range, the reason, a state badge, a warning when a party falls inside. The owner's look adds the cover picker and approve, decline and ask buttons; the animator's look adds withdraw.

components.name: Party list
components.what: A stack of party tickets by time: the phone view of the day, today's party and the upcoming ones for an animator.

components.name: Order list
components.what: The inbox: order tickets newest first, filtered by the chips; on phones the order detail opens under the selected ticket.

components.name: Leave list
components.what: A stack of leave request tickets: pending and decided for the owner, mine for an animator.

components.name: Day summary
components.what: The row of count pills in the day header: with deposit, unassigned, clashes, deposit missing.

components.name: Count pill
components.what: Day summary pill with a big number and a label, outlined in ok, warning or danger color.

components.name: Schedule grid
components.what: Day grid with an hours header and one animator lane per row, a warning-tinted top lane for parties without an animator; replaced by the party list on phones.

components.name: Animator lane
components.what: One row of the schedule grid: the animator's name cell and a lane with their small party tickets placed by time, a leave block and a clash band. Looks: open (no animator, amber) and tall (two parties overlap).

components.name: Animator name
components.what: An animator's name in display type with their role under it; heads a lane on the grid and a row on the absence roster.

components.name: Clash band
components.what: Hatched amber band over the overlapping hour of one animator, with a warning badge naming the overlap.

components.name: Leave block
components.what: Dashed, hatched block in an animator lane for hours they are off.

components.name: Decision list
components.what: Three-up grid of decision cards under the schedule; one column on phones.

components.name: Decision card
components.what: Card for one thing the owner must decide: a party without an animator, a clash, or a missing deposit, with who is free and one button per choice.

components.name: Order detail
components.what: Panel for the selected order: large order ticket, stage pills, the decision block for its state, facts and family history; sticky on desktop, opens under the selected ticket on phones.

components.name: Stage pills
components.what: Row of six pills from order to party, done ones tinted, the current one filled with ink.

components.name: Deposit banner
components.what: Solid red banner on a booking without a deposit, with the note, the last reminder and two actions; it is the only solid red block.

components.name: Party timeline
components.what: Vertical list of the booking's steps from order to feedback, with a count of done steps in the card header.

components.name: Step
components.what: One step of the party's path: a dot on the line, the step name and when it happened. Looks: done (teal), missing (red, the deposit), next (accent ring) and to do (muted).

components.name: Providers table
components.what: Outside suppliers for a party, one provider row each.

components.name: Provider row
components.what: One outside supplier: what they bring, who they are, and a confirmed or pending badge.

components.name: Message thread
components.what: Messages sent to the parent, oldest first, with the composer under them.

components.name: Message
components.what: One message to the parent: channel and time above a bubble; a deposit reminder gets a red-tinted bubble.

components.name: Message composer
components.what: Channel switch, text area and send button under the thread.

components.name: Family list
components.what: The families that match the search and filter: a table with sortable columns on desktop, a stack of family rows as tickets on phones.

components.name: Family row
components.what: One family: name, parent and phone, children with birthdays, party count and last party, tags, open order, and a red badge if a deposit was ever missing. A table row on desktop, a pressable ticket on phones; the selected one is tinted.

components.name: Family card
components.what: The selected family's facts, children as badges and their party history.

components.name: Party history
components.what: Past parties of a family: date and child, package, guests, with a red badge on a party whose deposit was missing.

components.name: Birthday list
components.what: Children with a birthday in the next 30 days, one birthday row each.

components.name: Birthday row
components.what: One upcoming birthday: the date, the child and what they turn, the family, and either the booked state or a write button.

components.name: Absence roster
components.what: Who is away in the coming weeks: one absence row per animator.

components.name: Absence row
components.what: One animator with a chip per leave range: pending, approved, or declined struck through.

components.name: Cover picker
components.what: Under a pending leave that hits a party: the warning note and a chip per other animator to cover it.

components.name: Stat grid
components.what: Two-up grid of stat tiles: pending and uncovered for the owner; parties, hours, amount and bonus for an animator.

components.name: Stat tile
components.what: Big number and label; a money figure not yet set shows the unset value instead of a number.

components.name: Leave request form
components.what: New leave request: from and to dates, whole day or hours, a reason, a hint on what the owner sees, and send.

components.name: Address block
components.what: Address in display type with the how-to-find-it note under it, inside a party ticket.

components.name: Pay list
components.what: The month's parties for an animator with a count in the header and a total row where the amount stays unset.

components.name: Pay line
components.what: One party in the month's pay: date, child and package, hours and state (done, today tinted, upcoming muted), with a red badge if that deposit is missing.

components.name: Booking edit dialog
components.what: Opens from Edit on a booking to change date, time, address, package, guests and animator.

components.name: Animator picker
components.what: Chooses the animator for a party, free ones first with why the others are busy; on the day screen the free ones are also offered as direct buttons.

components.name: Schedule dialog
components.what: Sets or moves the date and time of an order or party with a calendar, a time and the animator, opened from Schedule and Other time.

components.name: Deposit received confirm
components.what: Asks the owner to confirm the deposit came in before the red state clears.

components.name: Reply dialog
components.what: Writes to the parent from an order: channel switch, text and send, opened from Reply to parent and Ask for the address.

components.name: Decline leave dialog
components.what: Opens from Decline on a pending leave; asks for a short note the animator will see.

components.name: Add absence dialog
components.what: Owner adds an absence for an animator: animator, dates and note.

components.name: Leave date picker
components.what: Calendar in a popover for the from and to dates of a leave request, with today marked and parties on those days shown.

components.name: Withdraw leave confirm
components.what: Asks the animator to confirm withdrawing a pending request.

components.name: Add provider dialog
components.what: Adds an outside supplier to a party: what, who and state.

components.name: New family dialog
components.what: Creates a family with parent, phone and children.

components.name: Month picker
components.what: Switches the pay screen to another month.

components.name: Pay error report
components.what: Lets the animator flag a wrong or missing party in the month to the owner with a note; the mock-up shows only the note saying the owner checks pay at month end, so the trigger goes next to it.

notComponents.why: Padding and a rule between the blocks of the order detail; each block holds a different part (order ticket and stages, decision, facts, family), so the wrapper is layout only.
